scope: LOCAL synthetic fixtures, actual Horizon modules; no merchant tests

results.name: Real-template summary: title/vendor/SKU/currency, pending favorites and no fabricated rating
Gallery: selected main image, thumbnails, Arrow/Home/End/Space keyboard navigation
Native variant request updates exact purchasable ID, current/compare prices, discount, SKU and image
Unavailable variant remains selected and cannot add; availability/quantity update without fallback
Impossible option combination clears variant ID/price and never substitutes first available
Direct unavailable variant URL renders its genuine unavailable state
Pending variant blocks submit until exact response settles
Variant fetch failure locks stale purchase; explicit retry restores server-confirmed selection
Rapid option changes ignore aborted/stale response and preserve latest variant
Native quantity plus/minus obey min/max/increment and reject invalid typed quantity
Native cart POST uses selected variant/exact quantity; confirmed native cart count and success only after response
Rejected add shows truthful server error and no success; recoverable retry remains possible
Unknown POST outcome stays locked with cart link and no automatic retry/success
Confirmed add followed by cart refresh failure never claims confirmation
Typed content panels: actual description/spec/additional only, keyboard tab semantics and no invented reviews
Genuine media only: video flag/native deferred markup, model static preview, empty gallery has no placeholder product
Required selling-plan products are explicitly unavailable until plan integration, no arbitrary plan
Native recommendation request renders only returned products; no catalog/random fallback
No-JavaScript baseline retains media, readable panels, variant GET fallback and real product POST
Responsive desktop/laptop/tablet/mobile: no horizontal overflow at 320/390/767/768/1023/1024/1439/1440
axe A/AA on desktop/mobile PDP and changed/out-of-stock state
Labeled local screenshots saved; no browser runtime exceptions
